name: Mascarpone Mac 'n Cheese
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors

ingredients.item: 1 cup heavy whipping cream, whipped to soft peaks

steps: Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat. Whisk in flour and cook until light blond color is achieved.
Add remaining ingredients except for macaroni and whipped cream. Bring to a boil until reduced by half. Remove from heat and gently fold in cream.
Place macaroni in the bottom of a 9x13-inch square baking pan. Pour cheese mixture over and bake in a 350°F oven for 25 minutes, or until bubbly on top and puffed up. Remove and serve.
